dedupe_keys.name: climate equity reference calculator web interface

description: cerc-web is the web interface to the Climate Equity Reference Calculator. Its developers let users select equity parameters and calculate national contributions to global mitigation effort based on historical emissions and financial capacity. The JOSS paper identifies the separate C engine and core database. The own GitHub README documents PHP, SQLite and MySQL requirements and reports GPL-3.0, so the interface code is free. Spatial coverage is countries in the supporting database; temporal coverage follows its historical-emissions series and chosen policy horizon. Energy-system modellers could use an allocation as a policy constraint in transition scenarios. That downstream use is an inference; the calculator does not optimize a grid or establish that a chosen equity rule is agreed. A caveat is that normative parameter choices and data revisions can materially change national shares. The web code alone is not a runnable engine, and the separate database and engine terms must be checked before deployment. No directly related catalogue record was found. The article and own README were read without installing the server or obtaining its database.
